propositions: recheck-review currently refuses any finding state unconditionally, but should accept bugfix-size-attestation blocks when the ticket carries a current accepted plan-review attestation

a recheck-review acceptance for bugfix-size-attestation requires the block to contain exactly one finding with that criterion and the attestation to bucket as accepted (not absent, stale-material, mismatch, invalid, or infra)

the retrigger eligibility decision must read only durable Gerrit state and the ticket store, resolving ticket id from commit message via ticket_for_commit_message and re-classifying the attestation using the gate's own privileged classifier

label copy conditions (NO_CODE_CHANGE, TRIVIAL_REBASE) incorrectly propagate bugfix-size-attestation findings across patchsets even after attestation is earned, because the finding's evidence (ticket state) can change without code changes
